$schema_note: PersuAId locked design tokens extracted from Electrum AI Visibility CONVR reference deck. LLM fills content slots only — never invent new palettes or layouts.

title_two_tone.note: Electrum headlines emphasize the punchline in a second color on the same line/block, not a uniform flat-white sentence. Split title into { lead, emphasis } — lead=text_muted-or-text weight-bold, emphasis=accent-or-text weight-bold, same fontSize, same line.

title_align_variants.note: Data-dense slides (bar charts, tables, matrices) use left-aligned kicker+title so the headline composes with the chart instead of floating as a poster over it. Card-grid / quote-grid / synthesis slides keep centered.

chrome.footer_left: {agency}  ·  © {year}. All Rights Reserved. Confidential Do Not Distribute.
chrome.agency_mark_note: Real Redcomm 'R.' logomark, extracted from the Electrum reference deck (white on transparent, 99×145px, lock aspect ratio at h/w=145/99). Use this image via addFooterBranding — never render the client name alone as the sole footer-right element, and never substitute a different/invented agency mark.

icons.note: Electrum's own reference deck uses ordinary single-glyph icons directly in its driver/insight lists (see the 'Why does this happen?' sidebar and the LLM-engine slide: 📰💬🌐⚡🧠✓🤝) — match that plainly, one glyph per line, leading the text run, never more than one per row and never purely decorative filler.

cover_motif.note: Electrum cover/section-break pattern: one real brand/product photo reused across title, section-break, and closing CTA slides with a dark gradient overlay (left-to-right, ~55% black at the text edge fading to ~15% at the image edge) plus a rounded 'search bar' pill graphic wrapping the section label. This is the only sanctioned imagery archetype — never AI-generated decorative art.

anti_slop.imagery_policy: Use real brand photography for covers when available. Compose UI mockups from shapes+text. Charts/tables must be native drawing APIs — never raster AI art.

client_overrides.note: Per deck, override only: colors.accent (+ deep/stroke/banner derived), client name, logos, cover image path. Do not change layout geometry.
